meta.name: bids
meta.description: Use this skill when working with Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) datasets: organizing neuroscience and biomedical data (MRI, EEG, MEG, iEEG, PET, microscopy, NIRS, motion capture, EMG, MR spectroscopy, behavioral), querying BIDS layouts, validating compliance, converting DICOM to BIDS, writing metadata sidecars, or creating BIDS derivatives.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理神经影像数据为BIDS标准格式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常处理MRI/EEG等神经影像数据并需要符合BIDS标准。
copy.tagline_en: Organize neuroimaging data into BIDS standard format
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently work with MRI/EEG neuroimaging data and need BIDS compliance.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你整理神经科学数据（MRI、EEG 等）为 BIDS 标准格式，查询数据集中的文件，验证合规性，转换 DICOM 到 BIDS，以及编写元数据。
howto.when: 当你需要组织或处理脑成像数据（如 MRI、EEG、MEG），或准备上传到 OpenNeuro 等仓库时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个 DICOM 文件夹转换成 BIDS 格式。
验证一下我的 BIDS 数据集是否符合规范。
查询 subject-01 的 T1w 文件路径。
say.note: Claude 会使用 PyBIDS 查询并返回结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you organize neuroscience data (MRI, EEG, etc.) into BIDS standard format, query dataset files, validate compliance, convert DICOM to BIDS, and write metadata.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to organize or process brain imaging data (e.g., MRI, EEG, MEG) or prepare data for upload to repositories like OpenNeuro.

say_en.text: Convert this DICOM folder to BIDS format.
say_en.note: Claude will guide using HeuDiConv or similar tools.

say_en.text: Validate my BIDS dataset for compliance.
say_en.note: Claude will run bids-validator and report issues.

say_en.text: Query the T1w file path for subject-01.
say_en.note: Claude will use PyBIDS to query and return results.
